title: 받침이란? 7개 대표 소리
objective: Find the batchim in a syllable block and read ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ correctly.
summary: Learn what a batchim is and how to say the seven final sounds.

task.title: Read and find batchim
task.line: Look at the bottom consonant of each block, then write, choose, or build the right sound.

letters.sound: A consonant written at the bottom of a syllable block.
letters.as: In 밤, ㅁ is the batchim: 바 + ㅁ.

letters.sound: [k̚] [t̚] [p̚] — block the air (ㄱ: back of the tongue, ㄷ: tongue tip, ㅂ: lips), but do not release it.
letters.as: Like k in 'book', t in 'hot', p in 'cup', said softly.

letters.sound: [n] [m] [ŋ] [l] — hold the sound; it can go on.
letters.as: Like n in 'sun', m in 'gum', ng in 'song', l in 'feel'.

exercises: Write the batchim (bottom consonant) of each block: ① 산 ② 국 ③ 입
Write the final sound — n, m, or ng: ① 곰 ② 강 ③ 돈
Put the two parts together, then write the block and its romanization: ① 바 + ㅂ ② 마 + ㄹ ③ 드 + ㄷ
Choose the word that ends with the given sound: ① [m]: 사람 · 사랑 · 사실 ② [ŋ]: 시간 · 이름 · 수영 ③ [l]: 서점 · 서울 · 서랍
answers: ① ㄴ ② ㄱ ③ ㅂ
① m ② ng ③ n
① 밥 (bap) ② 말 (mal) ③ 듣 (deut)
① 사람 ② 수영 ③ 서울
